sloka: उत्कर्षन्त्यां च रशनां क्रुद्धायां मयि पक्षिणि ।स्रस्यमाने च वसने ततो दृष्टा त्वया ह्यहम् ।। ५.३८.१७।।।।
transliteration: utkarṣantyāṁ ca raśanāṁ kruddhāyāṁ mayi pakṣiṇi ।srasyamāne ca vasane tato dṛṣṭā tvayā hyaham ।। 5.38.17।।।।

translations.english: 'My upper cloth was slipping. I was trying to pull up my waist string angrily when you saw me.
